description: This file defines the NutritionContext for managing nutrition-related state and actions in a React frontend application. It provides context provider component, manages state related to meals, and exposes methods for listing, adding, updating, and deleting meals via backend API calls.

methods.name: NutritionProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides nutrition state and actions to its children components, managing meal data and interfacing with backend API.

methods.name: listMeals
methods.description: Fetches the list of meals from backend API and updates state.

methods.name: addMeal
methods.description: Adds a new meal via backend API and updates state.

methods.name: updateMeal
methods.description: Updates an existing meal via backend API and updates state.

methods.name: deleteMeal
methods.description: Deletes a meal via backend API and updates state.
